catalogue.title: Shop catalogue: weight and size
catalogue.intro: What the shop needs to price a product: its category, and its packed weight and size per unit. Without its own weight or its category's (Pricing → Weight by category), a product shows "price on request" in the shop.
catalogue.onlyMissing: Only products the shop can't weigh
